text:
maria: Quick sync: propose a compact ingest envelope + canonicalizer to control cardinality and make billing deterministic. Keep header small, payload as pointer.
sam: sketch please.
maria: header: {env, service, cost_key, dedupe_key, payload_ref, enrich_hint}. payload_ref -> cold store.
devon: dedupe_key+canonicalizer helps avoid double-charging if trace+metric both emit. window? 5s?
lekha: 5s ok but must shard dedupe state by cost_key to avoid hot shards. enforce header <=6 keys at gateway.
maria: canonicalizer merges same dedupe_key within window and writes canonical billing doc (hot index) for 90d; raw envelopes archived.
natalie: finance: need near-realtime availability for chargeback dashboards. SLA: canonical doc within 1m.
sam: enrichment: keep enrich_hint short and TTLed (24h default). billing_hint must be present at ingest for fallback.
devon: compatibility: provide a legacy mapping service (trace_id -> cost_key) for 6 months so dashboards don't break.
lekha: ops: require gzip, max header size 512B, warn on payload_ref >128B. add metric for top cardinality offenders.
maria: canary plan: feature-flagged ingest, 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. gates: per-tenant delta visible in Console; rollback on >10% unexpected cost delta or >0.5% error uptick.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-envelopes -> 2026-04-02 03:30 UTC.
natalie: add expected delta estimates for small/med/large tenants in RFC and auto-exclude tenants with >5% projected delta.
maria: action: I'll write RFC v2 with schema, canonicalizer contract, migration checklist, and canary metrics. owners: @sam @devon @lekha. follow-up meeting next week.
